description:
Shelf. ColorOS/OnePlus 'At a Glance'.
Shelf provides a variety of widgets that let you access important information or services from apps with ease. Removing will also be unable to access third-party widgets (these are different from the 'normal' widgets in any launcher) in ColorOS 16/OxygenOS 16
Swipe down on the Home screen to enter Shelf.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.coloros.assistantscreen
